_about: Live Clips streamer registry, phase 1 (docs/live-clips/RESEARCH.md section 3). Keys are platform:login. `campaign`: streamers with a public clipping campaign or Kick's clipping program on Nov 18 2026 (clyper.io listing; permission to clip within their rules). `block`: streamers who object to clip channels or have written to us; add to STUDIO_LIVE_BLOCK on Render for an instant block without a deploy.
